Yes, they can. Beta blockers generally hold your heart rate down, so the usual zones based on a max heart rate or an age formula can read too low for the effort you're actually putting in. How your own dose and medication affect that is a question for your doctor or pharmacist, and they can tell you whether to keep using heart rate at all.

In the meantime, effort-based pacing works regardless. The talk test and a simple 1 to 10 effort scale hold up, and so does pace on easy runs. If you want, I can build your runs around effort rather than heart rate.
